kaikki_vikisozluk.t: From Sanskrit कश्मीर (kaśmīra) probably via Middle or Classical Persian کَشْمِیر (kašmīr).
g: alternative form of كَشْمِير (kašmīr): Kashmir (a contested geographic region of South Asia in the northern part of the Indian subcontinent, located between (and de facto divided between) India, Pakistan and China)
